note: H230: the size gate reads the INDEX while commit_scoped.sh commits the WORKING TREE with --only

controls.name: C0_gate_discriminates
controls.must_fire_because: same repo, same file: a small staged append is green and a >1 MiB one is red, so the size gate has two reachable states
controls.can_fail_because: the gate is always red or always green

controls.name: C1_only_ignores_the_index
controls.must_fire_because: `git commit --only` landed a line that was never staged, so the premise that the commit path skips the index is observed and not read off a man page

falsifiers.name: F1_staged_oversize_refused
falsifiers.can_fail_because: a staged >1 MiB file is refused
falsifiers.fires_when: a staged >1 MiB file is refused

falsifiers.name: F2_unstaged_oversize_lands
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the gate is green and `--only` lands >1 MiB anyway
falsifiers.refutes: that the size gate covers the path that commits
falsifiers.fires_when: the gate is green and `--only` lands >1 MiB anyway

falsifiers.name: F3_foreign_add_flips_my_verdict
falsifiers.refutes: that my verdict depends only on my own work

no_deps_reason: every arm builds its own scratch repo from a copy of githygiene.py; nothing outside this spike is read at run time
falsifier: a staged >1 MiB file passing, or an unstaged one being refused, or `--only` declining to commit a line that was never staged
